title: Myles Garrett refuses to recruit Aaron Donald but would be ‘excited to be his partner in crime’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Myles Garrett refuses to recruit Aaron Donald but would be ‘excited to be his partner in crime’
sources.description: Rams star Myles Garrett discusses Aaron Donald's possible return from retirement, why he won't pressure the future Hall of Famer and how he's embracing a leadership role without trying to change the Rams' culture.
